speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to begin my evaluation, could you tell me how many weeks have passed since your first symptoms started? Additionally, does the pain travel below the knee, or does it stay above it?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L5-S1) due to acute mechanical injury during exercise.
